verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs say it can export journal entries into QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic file without re-keying data. That is the core of the story. However, the wording describes an export, and nothing shows the entries sync automatically after each payroll run rather than needing a user-triggered export. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic or ongoing sync (not one-off export), details on account mapping or sync configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero

citations.quote: Export journal entries from ADP into QuickBooks®, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic output file without re-keying data.
